title: Scene enum name must match scene's exported component
answers: How must Scene enum names relate to scene components?
How to add a new core scene?
body:
- `frontend/src/scenes/sceneTypes.ts:Scene` comment: enum value must match the first and only exported component of the scene, so its chunks can be preloaded in parallel.
- Routes (`manifest.routes`, `scenes.ts:routes`) reference scenes by `Scene` name; `scenes/appScenes.ts:appScenes` maps Scene keys to imports; product scenes come via `...productScenes`.
- New core scene: add `Scene` enum entry AND `appScenes` entry. Scene may export default component or `export const scene: SceneExport = { logic, component }`.
- Unverified: no check was found that enforces the name match; how build-products.mjs resolves it wasn't confirmed.
applies: Scene registration; preloading break is silent if names drift.
